sottos-payload.note: Private Sottos Payload CMS MCP server. Requires Clerk OAuth through the MCP client login flow; API keys are not supported. OAuth opens https://sottos-web.vercel.app/admin when an admin session exists, otherwise https://sottos-web.vercel.app/sign-in. Expected tools: posts/tags/categories/media find/update/create where safe, plus uploadMedia for base64 image uploads. Users tools must not be exposed. Delete tools should normally stay disabled; if enabled later, clients must confirm before use and prefer draft/unpublish rollback paths.
